# Code of Conduct

We are committed to a respectful, inclusive, and professional project environment.

Communicate constructively, welcome different viewpoints, focus feedback on the work, respect privacy and licensing, and avoid publishing sensitive information.

Harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, spam, deliberate disruption, privacy violations, malicious code, unsafe files, and intentionally misleading contributions are not acceptable.

This policy applies to issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions, and other project spaces. Report concerns to the repository owner through the contact options on the [GitHub profile](https://github.com/samusa099). Do not use a public issue for private or sensitive reports. Security concerns must follow `SECURITY.md`.

The repository owner may remove violating material and restrict participation for serious or repeated violations.
